_meta.title: MarketStack eod/latest frozen at 2026-05-22 for a cohort of intl names
_meta.fact: As of 2026-06-03, MarketStack eod/latest returns 2026-05-22 (one name 05-20) for these 68 names while US names are fresh (Jun-2/3). All are source=MarketStack. fetch_prices_marketstack uses the EOD endpoint (verified), so this is MS's own EOD data, not an intraday/endpoint mixup.
_meta.status: UNDETERMINED — temporary feed gap vs rolling ~12d lag. NOT plan/exchange-gating (MarketStack does not gate EOD by exchange; the v2 'not available in your plan' 406 was v2-endpoint access tiering, a red herring). #48 escalation is ON HOLD pending diagnosis.
diagnosis_pending: Tomorrow's cohort date: advances -> rolling lag (keep exclusion until a fresh source via #48); frozen -> feed gap.
MarketStack support ticket: why is eod for these names frozen at 05-22, and when does it resolve? (feed-gap question, NOT a plan question).
_meta.effect: These tickers are EXCLUDED from the all_prices price age-floor's stale fraction so the floor does not FAIL on a known, under-diagnosis vendor lag (it would otherwise FAIL ~Mon Jun 8: 68/306 = 22% > 0.15). They are LOGGED every run and still PUBLISH (stale) — this is documented degradation, NOT a silent quieting. Only cohort names that are STILL stale (>STALE_DAYS) are exempted; as MS refreshes a name it re-enters the floor automatically. Staleness in any name NOT on this list still gates normally.
_meta.remove_when: MarketStack feed catches up for these names (delete this list, or it self-narrows as names refresh) OR #48 sources fresh intl EOD for them.
